info.name: OpenText™ Core Application Security Web API Explorer ApiKeyManagement Vulnerabilities API

params.name: releaseId
params.description: The release id

params.name: filters
params.description:
A delimited list of field filters.

Field name and value should be separated by a colon (:).

Multiple fields should be separated by a plus (+). Multiple fields are treated as an AND condition. Example, fieldname1:value+fieldname2:value

Multiple values for a field should be separated by a pipe (|). Mulitple values for a field are treated as an OR condition. Example, fieldname1:value1|value2

Filtering is not supported for the following fields: auditPendingAuditorStatus, auditPendingSuppression, checkId, closedDate, closedStatus, falsePositiveChallenge, instanceId, pci1_2, sink, source, stig6, suppressedBy, timeToFixDays

params.name: orderBy
params.description: The field name to order the results by.

params.name: orderByDirection
params.description: The direction to order the results by. ASC and DESC are valid values.

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma separated list of fields to return.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset of the starting record. 0 indicates the first record.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum records to return. The maximum value allowed is in Tenant's 'Max Number of Vulnerabilities Records Per API Call'.

params.name: excludeFilters
params.description: Indicates if filter data should be excluded in the return value. Value defaults to false if not specified.

params.name: includeFixed
params.description: Indicates if items that have been fixed should be included in the return value. Value defaults to false if not specified.

params.name: includeSuppressed
params.description: Indicates if items that have been suppressed should be included in the return value. Value defaults to false if not specified.

params.name: fortifyAviator
params.description: Indicates if SAST Aviator audited items should be included in the return value. Value defaults to null if not specified.

params.name: keywordSearch
params.description: Used for keyword searches

params.name: lastModifiedDate
params.description: Indicates the last modified date of the vulnerability. The format of the date is YYYY/MM/DD.
